import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

def test_download():
    url = 'https://www.google.com'
    output = Path('test.html')
    if output.exists(): output.unlink()
    
    # First download
    subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/src/downloader.py', url, str(output)], check=True)
    assert output.exists()
    
    # Second download (should be fast/no-op)
    subprocess.run(['python3', '/app/src/downloader.py', url, str(output)], check=True)
    assert output.exists()
    
    print('Test passed!')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_download()
